events.headline: Mercury launches AI-native Payroll
events.summary: Launched payroll, benefits and tax-compliance tools for eligible U.S. customers; pricing announced on 2026-10-20 is $0 through 2026-12-31, then $100/month plus $50 per person paid that month from 2027-01-01.

events.headline: ChatGPT and Claude can take actions on Mercury accounts
events.summary: Customers can ask ChatGPT or Claude to move money, pay recipients and categorize transactions, with approval required before money moves.

events.headline: Priority support added for Plus and Pro customers
events.summary: Plus and Pro subscribers gain faster, priority support; all customers retain round-the-clock support.

events.headline: Linked Mercury accounts gain direct transfers and automation
events.summary: Customers can connect multiple Mercury accounts, transfer directly between them, automate linked-account transfers and schedule recurring payments to external bank accounts.

events.headline: Mercury API adds real-time payments
events.summary: The API now supports payments arriving in seconds, including nights, weekends and holidays, for Mercury Business and Personal accounts provided through Column, N.A.

citations.title: Introducing Mercury Payroll
excerpts: October 20, 2026

citations.title: Mercury Launches AI-Native Payroll
excerpts: Mercury Payroll lets founders pay employees and contractors and offer benefits from the same account they already use to manage their money, with AI-powered capabilities through Mercury Command\*\*\* that help simplify payroll tasks and reduce administrative work.

Promotional pricing of $0 applies through December 31, 2026. Beginning January 1, 2027, standard pricing of $100 per month for the platform, plus $50 per month for each person paid that month, will apply.

citations.title: Mercury Release Notes | Latest Features & Product Updates
excerpts: Take action on your Mercury account from ChatGPT and Claude You can now ask ChatGPT or Claude to move money, pay a recipient, or categorize transactions on your Mercury account. Every answer is grounded in your account data and nothing moves until you approve it.

Priority Support now available for Plus and Pro customers Customers on our Plus and Pro subscription plans will now get faster, priority support. All Mercury customers will still have access to 24/7 support.

All your accounts, connected Multiple Mercury accounts can now be connected to move money between them directly. Transfers between accounts on the same partner bank land in seconds, and auto-transfer rules keep money moving between linked accounts on the schedule you set. Plus, you can now send money to bank accounts outside of Mercury on a recurring basis.

**Send real-time payments with the Mercury API** You can now send real-time payments through the Mercury API. Set _realTimePayment_ as the _paymentMethod_ when you send money, and the funds will arrive in seconds, 24/7/365, including nights, weekends, and holidays.
Available on Mercury Business and Personal accounts provided through Column, N.A.
